narr: A cluster of severe thunderstorms with very large hail and heavy rain tracked along a warm front over southern WI during the morning. Numerous reports of very large hail were received, and also flash flooding in Milwaukee.
ev: Portions of lanes were closed on several highways due to high water. This included I-43 from Hampton Ave. to State St., highway 175 from Lloyd St. to Wisconsin Ave., and I-41 from Good Hope Rd. to North Ave. There was fairly significant street flooding at 20th and Capitol Dr. and on Humboldt Blvd. in the Riverwest neighborhood on the east side. Other street flooding occurred across all of northern Milwaukee County.
